description: Claim a free Random Profiles API key using an email address. Use this tool the FIRST time no key is configured — the key will be returned in the response and also emailed to the user as a receipt. Subsequent calls use the cached key automatically, so you only need to do this once per machine. ALWAYS ask the user for their real email before calling this — don't make one up.

email.description: Real email address to receive the key receipt. Will be used as the account identifier for usage tracking. Disposable domains are rejected.

name: claim_api_key
